title: Interviews with Anakah and Tristan, two personalities in one body

tellings.quote: I've done a series of interviews with two individuals who exist in one body. They used the names Anakah and Tristan. I've now completed 10 interviews with Anakah and Tristan.

plain: Two individuals who say they live in one body, using the names Anakah and Tristan, have sat for a series of ten interviews with Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a PhD who hosts the online channel New Thinking Allowed. Mishlove tells Michels he did the interviews himself, between 2024 and 2026. If they are what they say, two separate minds share one person.
